overview: The City Council approved a special permit for a drive-through ATM, advanced outdoor dining ordinance amendments on first reading, and authorized the submission of the CDBG Annual Action Plan. Councilors also engaged in extended debate over city finances and the municipal maintenance of private ways.

items.title: Remembrance of Senator Charles E. Shannon Jr.
items.summary: Approved a resolution dedicating the meeting to the memory of the late State Senator Charles E. Shannon Jr. and observed a moment of silence.

items.title: Committee Reports
items.summary: Approved joined committee reports covering a Capital Improvement Plan presentation, waste hauler regulations, and auto body facilities.

items.title: Special Permit: Bank of America Drive-Through ATM (3850 Mystic Valley Parkway)
items.summary: Approved a special permit to operate a drive-through ATM at the Meadow Glen Shopping Center with a 90-day review condition and waived the six-day comment period.

items.title: Food Truck and Common Victualler Licences
items.summary: Approved an employee appreciation food truck permit for Tufts University along with Common Victualler licenses for Quench Juice Cafe and Deep Cuts Deli and Brewery.

items.title: Executive Session: Centrella v. BJ's Wholesale Club and City Council
items.summary: Voted to enter executive session to discuss strategy regarding pending litigation before reconvening in open session.

items.title: CDBG Annual Action Plan
items.summary: Approved authorizing the mayor to submit the annual action plan for $1,423,649 in Community Development Block Grant funds to HUD, pending the six-day comment period.

items.title: Outdoor Dining Ordinance Amendments
items.summary: Approved for first reading an ordinance amending Chapter 14 regulations for outdoor dining to streamline permits and update safety and accessibility standards.

items.title: FY 2024 Budget Priorities Committee of the Whole
items.summary: Approved scheduling a Committee of the Whole meeting to discuss Council priorities for the FY 2024 city budget, sparking sharp council criticism regarding administrative communication and financial reporting.

items.title: Motorcycle Safety Awareness Period Resolution
items.summary: Approved a resolution proclaiming Motorcycle Safety Awareness Period in the City of Medford.

items.title: Middlesex Avenue Crosswalks and Traffic Enforcement
items.summary: Approved an inquiry into MassDOT plans for Middlesex Avenue crosswalks, amended to request directed police patrols to manage congestion near the local car wash.

items.title: Public Participation
items.summary: Heard public concerns regarding city maintenance policies and tax equity on private ways, bike lane impacts and bicycle regulations, and use of City Hall facilities.

items.title: Pothole Repair Inquiries
items.summary: Approved resolutions requesting administration updates on repairing potholes at George Street and Main Street, as well as on Boston Avenue between College Avenue and Harvard Street.

items.title: Immigrant Civic Participation
items.summary: Approved requesting the administration, Elections Department, and DEI Department to study and address barriers to civic and political participation among immigrant communities.

items.title: Municipal Civic Engagement Software
items.summary: Approved requesting the administration consider upgrading from Google Forms to professional municipal civic engagement software for public input.

items.title: Alden Memorial Chambers HVAC Ventilation
items.summary: Voted to refer issues regarding loud council chamber ventilation blowers to Reports Due and invited the facilities manager to appear.

items.title: City Hall Drop Box Mail Delivery
items.summary: Approved requesting the administration investigate delays in routing mail deposited into exterior City Hall drop boxes to departments.

items.title: Blasting and Permitting Update for 551 Winthrop Street
items.summary: Approved requesting a report from the Building Commissioner regarding site activity, prolonged blasting, and permitting status at 551 Winthrop Street.

items.title: Smart Growth and Use Table Revisions for Mystic Avenue
items.summary: Referred a proposal to review use table revisions and smart growth zoning tools along Mystic Avenue and key corridors to the Business, Cultural Arts, and Economic Development Subcommittee.

items.title: Settlement Claim: USAA / Constance White
items.summary: Approved a $3,450 property damage settlement for a 2018 collision involving a city fire truck.
